silicon_quenching_2.name: Quenching of Silicon - Level 2
silicon_quenching_2.description: Simulate the quenching process of Silicon by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions using the Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential. Detect the glass transition temperature (Tg), defined as the temperature at which the slope of density versus temperature changes. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
